blurb: Red Bank Marina is located on the Navesink River and offers various recreational activities including motorized boats, kayaks, SUPs, and pontoons. It is a family owned and operated marina and an authorized dealer for Tohatsu, Maycraft, and Yamaha. NJ requires a boater's safety certificate to rent a boat.
